primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events and percentage with treatment-emergent laboratory abnormalities, through 24 weeks plus 30 days.
safety_signal: TEAEs were reported in 89.3% (100 mg), 76.8% (30 mg), and 67.9% (placebo); serious AEs affected 2/56, 2/56, and 1/28 participants, respectively. No deaths were reported.
